ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels (~80-85%) with scattered high-intensity white and beige pixel clusters (~15-20%) forming circular and mottled patterns.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark ground with high-contrast white ring-shaped rosettes distributed across both lobes; a significant contiguous beige mottled patch is located on the distal edge of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, smooth V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 55 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular trailing edge characterized by high-frequency, low-amplitude serrations; significant textural jaggedness and morphological protrusions are visible on the distal lateral tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending from the median notch to the outer fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density distribution of circular, ring-like high-contrast pixel clusters (barnacle attachment scars) across the mid-to-distal regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, appearing as high-contrast, beige, calcified textural clusters extending beyond the fluke's structural boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: The density and circular uniformity of the 'O' shaped scarring pattern is the primary distinctive visual feature.
